Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We're privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word 'partner' over 'vendor', and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.

This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud's internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client's buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English

Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud's AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.

Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company's revenue growth and strategic partnership status.

A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. title: Business Development Representative (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script.O que você vai fazer aqui? Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e LinkedIn, gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos. Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença. Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas. Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar. Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo. O que buscamos? Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real. Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente. Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico. Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar. Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos. Pontos extra se... Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou SaaS B2B para o mercado mid-market. Tem familiaridade com ferramentas como HubSpot, Salesforce ou plataformas de sales engagement (Apollo, Outreach, etc.). Fala espanhol. O que oferecemos? Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta. Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva. Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About the Role

Job Title: Annotation & Review Specialist

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible;
minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a High school or above degree

Language Required : Polish

We are seeking for detail-oriented and quality-focused individuals to join our team as Annotation & Review Specialists. This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform annotation tasks on images and videos as per project guidelines.
  • Review annotated images and video content to ensure accuracy and quality standards are met.
  • Provide clear and constructive feedback on annotations and identify areas requiring correction or improvement.
  • Follow project instructions, workflows, and timelines consistently.
  • Maintain high attention to detail while handling large volumes of data.
  • Collaborate with the quality and project teams to improve annotation accuracy and efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High school or Bachelor's degree in mandatory.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with online tools/platforms.
  • Prior experience in annotation, data labeling, or quality review is an added advantage.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Fully remote opportunity, allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives, shaping the future of language technology.

Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.

This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.

About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.

Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.

Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.

Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.

The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.

Your work includes:

- Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

- Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

- Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

- Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

- Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

- Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

- Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

- Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

- Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.

Requirements

You bring:

- At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

- Strong Python skills

- Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

- Real production experience with ML on AWS

- Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

- Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

- Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

- A strong eye for correctness and data quality

- Business level English

- The ability to work independently in a small remote team

- A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership

Conditions

- 12 month B2B contract

- Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

- Flat structure with direct communication

- Production product with real users and real data problems

- Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

- Compensation based on senior contractor level

The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.

Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na HugLabs, estamos construindo produtos de software movidos por IA para resolver problemas reais de empresas através de automação, agentes inteligentes, dados e sistemas escaláveis.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack com mentalidade de builder — alguém que goste de construir produtos de ponta a ponta, resolver problemas complexos e trabalhar com autonomia.

Não procuramos alguém apenas para executar tickets. Procuramos pessoas que queiram ajudar a construir o Brasil por meio de pesquisa e engenharia de ponta.

O que você vai fazer:

Você trabalhará diretamente na construção e evolução dos produtos da HugLabs, incluindo:

  • Plataformas SaaS B2B
  • Sistemas baseados em IA e automação
  • APIs e integrações complexas
  • Interfaces modernas de alta performance
  • Sistemas escaláveis e resilientes
  • Arquitetura de software e melhoria contínua do stack

Você terá espaço para propor melhorias, desafiar decisões técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução dos produtos.

Stack principal

Backend

  • PHP (Laravel)
  • Go (Golang)
  • APIs REST
  • PostgreSQL / bancos relacionais
  • Redis
  • Filas e processamento assíncrono

Frontend

  • React
  • TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Next.Js (diferencial)
  • Tailwind CSS

Infraestrutura (plus)

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS / Cloud
  • CI/CD
  • Observabilidade

O que buscamos

Você provavelmente vai se destacar se:

  • Gosta de construir software de verdade
  • Aprende rápido tecnologias novas
  • Tem senso de ownership
  • Consegue navegar bem entre frontend e backend
  • Entende trade-offs técnicos
  • Tem preocupação com performance, escalabilidade e qualidade
  • É pragmático(a): sabe equilibrar velocidade e excelência

Requisitos

  • Experiência com PHP (preferencialmente Laravel)
  • Experiência com React
  • Experiência com APIs e arquitetura de software
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais
  • Familiaridade com versionamento (Git)
  • Experiência colocando software em produção

Diferenciais Importantes

  • Experiência com Go (Golang)
  • Conhecimento em DevOps / infraestrutura cloud
  • Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência com CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com produtos SaaS
  • Interesse ou experiência com IA

O que oferecemos

  • Participação direta na construção de produtos de IA
  • Ambiente com alto alinhamento e alta autonomia
  • Decisões rápidas e pouca burocracia
  • Contato próximo com founders e time técnico
  • Espaço real para crescimento

title: Annotation & Review Specialist(Polish)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Annotation & Review Specialist(Polish) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About the Role

Job Title: Annotation & Review Specialist

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible;
minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a High school or above degree

Language Required : Polish

We are seeking for detail-oriented and quality-focused individuals to join our team as Annotation & Review Specialists. This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform annotation tasks on images and videos as per project guidelines.
  • Review annotated images and video content to ensure accuracy and quality standards are met.
  • Provide clear and constructive feedback on annotations and identify areas requiring correction or improvement.
  • Follow project instructions, workflows, and timelines consistently.
  • Maintain high attention to detail while handling large volumes of data.
  • Collaborate with the quality and project teams to improve annotation accuracy and efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High school or Bachelor's degree in mandatory.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with online tools/platforms.
  • Prior experience in annotation, data labeling, or quality review is an added advantage.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Fully remote opportunity, allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives, shaping the future of language technology.

Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.Your work includes:
- Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection
- Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats
- Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production
- Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases
- Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value
- Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling
- Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time
- Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS
- Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flowsThis role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.Requirements You bring:
- At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience
- Strong Python skills
- Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3
- Real production experience with ML on AWS
- Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning
- Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data
- Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content
- A strong eye for correctness and data quality
- Business level English
- The ability to work independently in a small remote team
- A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownershipConditions
- 12 month B2B contract
- Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap
- Flat structure with direct communication
- Production product with real users and real data problems
- Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence
- Compensation based on senior contractor levelThe hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \&34;Desenvolvedor Backend Node Js Sênior 1004591\&34; em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Atividades:

Design de arquiteturas de microserviços escaláveis.

Aplicação e uso de DDD (Domain-Driven Design) e EDA (Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos).

Tomada de decisões tecnológicas, mentoria de equipes e resolução de problemas complexos em produção.

Requisitos:

Idiomas: Espanhol Avançado (necessário para comunicação)

Domínio de princípios de Clean Code e SOLID.

Experiência no provisionamento de infraestruturas na AWS e automação de pipelines de CI/CD.

Modelagem avançada e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

Ensino superior (Redes, Análise de sistemas, Sistemas de informação, Engenharia)

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits;
candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension

Hours: 40 hours per week

About the Role

The Inbound team develops highly scalable solutions to determine item attribute values (such as color, material, and style) and verify merchandise authenticity. The Senior Applied Scientist will own the development and deployment of machine learning solutions while influencing the technical direction of the team.

This role works closely with Tech Leads, Product, and Engineering partners to design and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, along with a strong focus on building robust production-ready systems and mentoring team members.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards.
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and support informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key system components and solutions to ensure business needs are met.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor team members and help establish domain expertise across the team.
  • Contribute to the company's intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and applied Machine Learning.
  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or 8+ years of equivalent industry experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in large-scale production environments.
  • Deep understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning algorithms and techniques, including CNNs, transformers, GANs, optimizers, and regularization, as well as experiment design and best practices such as A/B testing, training and serving pipelines, and feature engineering.
  • Extensive experience with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy and pandas, and Machine Learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with experiment automation frameworks such as Ray Tune, Weights & Biases (W&B), and Kubeflow.
  • Experience with cloud technologies including AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python.

Preferred Requirements

  • PhD preferred in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Background applying Machine Learning techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality models.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.

The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)

Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

description:

Location: São Paulo (mandatory residence). 100% remote work, with occasional on-site meetings when required

Contract type: Permanent

Employment type: Full-time

About the role

From SOTEC Consulting – ASTEK Group, we are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong experience in high-performance, real-time data-driven environments to join an international project within a demanding and collaborative technology ecosystem.

This role combines advanced frontend development in Angular with backend capabilities in Java (Spring Boot or similar), contributing to scalable solutions, API integrations, and features focused on user experience and real-time data processing.

Responsibilities

- Develop advanced frontend applications using Angular in complex, high-traffic environments.

- Implement real-time data features (e.G., dynamic grids such as ag-Grid).

- Develop backend services in Java using microservices architecture (Spring Boot or equivalent frameworks).

- Design and implement RESTful APIs and handle JSON data structures.

- Contribute to the design and improvement of UX/UI interfaces and reusable components.

- Use AI tools to support UX design, code refactoring, template generation, and vulnerability remediation.

- Implement responsive and adaptive design principles.

- Collaborate in Agile/Scrum environments.

- Work with version control systems (Git).

Mandatory requirements

- +8 years of experience in frontend development with Angular.

- Strong experience in Java backend development, especially with microservices (Spring Boot or similar).

- Proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

- Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON data.

- Experience implementing real-time data features (e.G., ag-Grid).

- Experience using AI tools in development (UX, templates, refactoring, vulnerability detection/removal).

- Familiarity with responsive and adaptive design principles.

- Experience with Git or other version control systems.

- Minimum English level B2 (mandatory).

- Must be based in São Paulo (project requirement).

Nice to have

- Experience with state management libraries (NgRx, Akita).

- Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Experience with data visualization libraries (D3.Js, Chart.Js).

- Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.

- Experience in financial services or other real-time, data-intensive industries.

- Knowledge or experience with UX/UI design tools (Figma, Adobe XD).

- Spanish language is a plus.

What we offer

- Participation in high-impact international technology projects.

- Collaborative and multidisciplinary team culture.

- Continuous training and professional development plans.

- Additional benefits depending on the project and profile.

Why join SOTEC / ASTEK?

Being part of SOTEC Consulting means joining a company with 30 years of experience in the IT sector, backed by the strength of the ASTEK Group.

This integration gives you access to large-scale international projects, working with global teams and multicultural environments that foster your professional growth.

SOTEC is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, nationality, or gender identity. We actively strive to avoid any form of bias.

Take the next step in your career and join projects that are transforming the digital landscape.

Apply now!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.Js and Node.Js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake

Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field

Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health: We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect: We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability: We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Applied Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Applied Scientist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits;
candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension

Hours: 40 hours per week

About the Role

The Inbound team develops highly scalable solutions to determine item attribute values (such as color, material, and style) and verify merchandise authenticity. The Senior Applied Scientist will own the development and deployment of machine learning solutions while influencing the technical direction of the team.

This role works closely with Tech Leads, Product, and Engineering partners to design and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, along with a strong focus on building robust production-ready systems and mentoring team members.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards.
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and support informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key system components and solutions to ensure business needs are met.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor team members and help establish domain expertise across the team.
  • Contribute to the company's intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and applied Machine Learning.
  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or 8+ years of equivalent industry experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in large-scale production environments.
  • Deep understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning algorithms and techniques, including CNNs, transformers, GANs, optimizers, and regularization, as well as experiment design and best practices such as A/B testing, training and serving pipelines, and feature engineering.
  • Extensive experience with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy and pandas, and Machine Learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with experiment automation frameworks such as Ray Tune, Weights & Biases (W&B), and Kubeflow.
  • Experience with cloud technologies including AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python.

Preferred Requirements

  • PhD preferred in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Background applying Machine Learning techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality models.

Esta é uma posição funcional sênior, com responsabilidade de conduzir workshops, levantar e desafiar requisitos de negócio, desenhar processos TO-BE, configurar o Dynamics 365 SCM, apoiar testes e atuar lado a lado com stakeholders de negócio e times técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de manutenção, operações, supply chain, compras, estoque, armazém, produção e finanças.

  • Colaborar com desenvolvedores, arquitetos de solução, gerentes de projeto e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Recomendar boas práticas para Dynamics 365 SCM e processos de Asset Management.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sênior como consultor(a) funcional em Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Supply Chain Management.
  • Experiência hands-on em configuração do Dynamics 365 SCM.
  • Vivência em Asset Management, Enterprise Asset Management, manutenção industrial ou plant maintenance.
  • Forte entendimento de processos de manutenção: preventiva, corretiva, ordens de serviço, planejamento de manutenção, hierarquia de ativos e consumo de peças.
  • Experiência integrando Asset Management com compras, estoque, armazém, produção, custos ou finanças.
  • Capacidade de liderar workshops e se comunicar com stakeholders sêniores.
  • Experiência em elaboração de especificações funcionais, documentação de processos, scripts de teste e materiais de apoio a UAT.
  • Inglês fluente (mandatório) para reuniões, documentação e interação com times globais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em ambiente de consultoria / projeto.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Microsoft em Dynamics 365 SCM (MB-330 ou similares).
  • Experiência em setores industrial, manufatura, utilities, mineração, óleo & gás, logística ou facilities.
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, integrações, IoT ou sistemas externos de manutenção.
  • Experiência com migração de dados, planejamento de cutover e suporte a go-live.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PM, SAP EAM, Maximo, Infor EAM ou outros sistemas EAM.

Perfil

Buscamos um(a) profissional funcional sênior, capaz de traduzir requisitos de negócio de manutenção e supply chain em configuração e design funcional no Dynamics 365 SCM. Conhecimento técnico é bem-vindo, mas o foco principal está na expertise funcional em Dynamics 365 SCM e Asset Management.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We've built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we're revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We're working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong "sense of product" and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We're building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.

About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you're tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You've worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You've owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you've navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.

About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You'll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day's work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior's SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture

Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you'll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you'll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours

What's in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Contract Review Attorney
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contract Review Attorney em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.ComAt Headshots.Com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth.We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting.About the Role This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well.We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed.Key Responsibilities Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early. Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.What You Bring Experience & Qualifications Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams. 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus) Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.Why Join Us Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.IMPORTANT Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.Compensation:$40-60/hour depending on experience

Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM Consultant – Asset Management

Local: Brasil (Remoto)

Senioridade: Sênior

Idioma: Inglês fluente (obrigatório)

Modalidade: Consultoria / Projeto de Implementação

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Consultant com sólida experiência em Asset Management / Enterprise Asset Management para atuar em um projeto de implementação ou evolução do Dynamics 365.

O(a) profissional ideal é um(a) consultor(a) funcional sênior, com domínio dos processos de supply chain e manutenção — incluindo estrutura de ativos, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, ordens de serviço, peças de reposição, estoque, compras e integração de custos.

Esta é uma posição funcional sênior, com responsabilidade de conduzir workshops, levantar e desafiar requisitos de negócio, desenhar processos TO-BE, configurar o Dynamics 365 SCM, apoiar testes e atuar lado a lado com stakeholders de negócio e times técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de manutenção, operações, supply chain, compras, estoque, armazém, produção e finanças.
  • Analisar processos AS-IS e desenhar processos TO-BE para Asset Management e operações de manutenção.
  • Configurar o Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM, com foco no módulo de Asset Management.
  • Atuar com ativos, localizações funcionais, solicitações de manutenção, ordens de serviço, planos de manutenção, manutenção preventiva e corretiva e processos de peças de reposição.
  • Apoiar a integração entre Asset Management e os processos de estoque, compras, armazém, produção, custos e finanças.
  • Realizar análises fit-gap e elaborar documentação de design funcional.
  • Apoiar atividades de migração de dados (ativos, planos de manutenção, ordens de serviço, peças e histórico).
  • Definir e executar cenários de teste funcional, apoiar UAT, resolução de issues, cutover, go-live e hypercare.
  • Colaborar com desenvolvedores, arquitetos de solução, gerentes de projeto e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Recomendar boas práticas para Dynamics 365 SCM e processos de Asset Management.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sênior como consultor(a) funcional em Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Supply Chain Management.
  • Experiência hands-on em configuração do Dynamics 365 SCM.
  • Vivência em Asset Management, Enterprise Asset Management, manutenção industrial ou plant maintenance.
  • Forte entendimento de processos de manutenção: preventiva, corretiva, ordens de serviço, planejamento de manutenção, hierarquia de ativos e consumo de peças.
  • Experiência integrando Asset Management com compras, estoque, armazém, produção, custos ou finanças.
  • Capacidade de liderar workshops e se comunicar com stakeholders sêniores.
  • Experiência em elaboração de especificações funcionais, documentação de processos, scripts de teste e materiais de apoio a UAT.
  • Inglês fluente (mandatório) para reuniões, documentação e interação com times globais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em ambiente de consultoria / projeto.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Microsoft em Dynamics 365 SCM (MB-330 ou similares).
  • Experiência em setores industrial, manufatura, utilities, mineração, óleo & gás, logística ou facilities.
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, integrações, IoT ou sistemas externos de manutenção.
  • Experiência com migração de dados, planejamento de cutover e suporte a go-live.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PM, SAP EAM, Maximo, Infor EAM ou outros sistemas EAM.

Perfil

Buscamos um(a) profissional funcional sênior, capaz de traduzir requisitos de negócio de manutenção e supply chain em configuração e design funcional no Dynamics 365 SCM. Conhecimento técnico é bem-vindo, mas o foco principal está na expertise funcional em Dynamics 365 SCM e Asset Management.

title: K-Pop Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-Pop Influencers em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURFIZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth. Position OverviewWe are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide. As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Scm Consultant - Asset Management

Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM Consultant – Asset Management

Local: Brasil (Remoto)

Senioridade: Sênior

Idioma: Inglês fluente (obrigatório)

Modalidade: Consultoria / Projeto de Implementação

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Consultant com sólida experiência em Asset Management / Enterprise Asset Management para atuar em um projeto de implementação ou evolução do Dynamics 365.

O(a) profissional ideal é um(a) consultor(a) funcional sênior, com domínio dos processos de supply chain e manutenção — incluindo estrutura de ativos, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, ordens de serviço, peças de reposição, estoque, compras e integração de custos.

Esta é uma posição funcional sênior, com responsabilidade de conduzir workshops, levantar e desafiar requisitos de negócio, desenhar processos TO-BE, configurar o Dynamics 365 SCM, apoiar testes e atuar lado a lado com stakeholders de negócio e times técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de manutenção, operações, supply chain, compras, estoque, armazém, produção e finanças.
  • Analisar processos AS-IS e desenhar processos TO-BE para Asset Management e operações de manutenção.
  • Configurar o Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM, com foco no módulo de Asset Management.
  • Atuar com ativos, localizações funcionais, solicitações de manutenção, ordens de serviço, planos de manutenção, manutenção preventiva e corretiva e processos de peças de reposição.
  • Apoiar a integração entre Asset Management e os processos de estoque, compras, armazém, produção, custos e finanças.
  • Realizar análises fit-gap e elaborar documentação de design funcional.
  • Apoiar atividades de migração de dados (ativos, planos de manutenção, ordens de serviço, peças e histórico).
  • Definir e executar cenários de teste funcional, apoiar UAT, resolução de issues, cutover, go-live e hypercare.
  • Colaborar com desenvolvedores, arquitetos de solução, gerentes de projeto e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Recomendar boas práticas para Dynamics 365 SCM e processos de Asset Management.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sênior como consultor(a) funcional em Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Supply Chain Management.
  • Experiência hands-on em configuração do Dynamics 365 SCM.
  • Vivência em Asset Management, Enterprise Asset Management, manutenção industrial ou plant maintenance.
  • Forte entendimento de processos de manutenção: preventiva, corretiva, ordens de serviço, planejamento de manutenção, hierarquia de ativos e consumo de peças.
  • Experiência integrando Asset Management com compras, estoque, armazém, produção, custos ou finanças.
  • Capacidade de liderar workshops e se comunicar com stakeholders sêniores.
  • Experiência em elaboração de especificações funcionais, documentação de processos, scripts de teste e materiais de apoio a UAT.
  • Inglês fluente (mandatório) para reuniões, documentação e interação com times globais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em ambiente de consultoria / projeto.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Microsoft em Dynamics 365 SCM (MB-330 ou similares).
  • Experiência em setores industrial, manufatura, utilities, mineração, óleo & gás, logística ou facilities.
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, integrações, IoT ou sistemas externos de manutenção.
  • Experiência com migração de dados, planejamento de cutover e suporte a go-live.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PM, SAP EAM, Maximo, Infor EAM ou outros sistemas EAM.

Perfil

Buscamos um(a) profissional funcional sênior, capaz de traduzir requisitos de negócio de manutenção e supply chain em configuração e design funcional no Dynamics 365 SCM. Conhecimento técnico é bem-vindo, mas o foco principal está na expertise funcional em Dynamics 365 SCM e Asset Management.

As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.
