title: Arquiteto De Soluções Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto De Soluções Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vagaA FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.Compreensão e Análise de Negócio: ➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio. ➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor. ➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.). ➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um. ➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.Arquitetura e Design da Solução: ➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade. ➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência). ➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc). ➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades. ➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc). ➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas. ➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras. ➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.). ➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.Documentação e Apresentação: ➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa. ➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados. ➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme). ➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução. ➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo. ➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.Implementação e Operação: ➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução. ➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente. ➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.Requisitos Diferenciais: ➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição). ➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração. ➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução. ➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados. ➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas. ➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência: ➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos. ➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas. ➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.Conhecimentos Técnicos: ➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.). ➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços. ➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.Js, Cloud, etc.). ➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML). ➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia). ➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas. ➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git). ➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.Habilidades: ➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. ➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas. ➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas. ➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada. ➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis: ➢ Proatividade ➢ Pensamento analítico ➢ Orientação a resultados ➢ Colaboração ➢ Adaptabilidade ➢ Aprendizado contínuo

title: Tech Lead Reactjs
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead Reactjs em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

(Tech Lead React)A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora comoparte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas comoSmiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel?Atuar como referência técnica em frontend, liderando a construção e evolução de soluções digitais com foco em performance, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário. Como Tech Lead React, você será responsável por guiar o time nas decisões arquiteturais, garantir a qualidade das entregas e promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, fomentando um ambiente colaborativo, de aprendizado contínuo e alta performance.Como será seu dia a dia? Liderança e Mentoria: Alinhar objetivos, identificar necessidades de treinamento e garantir o nivelamento técnico da equipe. Gestão de Processos: Acompanhar o ciclo de desenvolvimento, mitigar riscos de entrega e apoiar o time de projetos em cronogramas e estimativas. Excelência Técnica: Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis, realizando revisões de código (code review) e garantindo a adoção de padrões de qualidade. Colaboração Multidisciplinar: Atuar próximo aos times de Design e Backend para implementação de interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e otimizadas. Melhoria Contínua: Identificar gargalos de performance no frontend e manter o projeto atualizado com as melhores práticas do mercado.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento frontend. Experiência sólida com TypeScript. Domínio profundo de React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API). Experiência prática com o framework Remix. Domínio de Tailwind CSS, além de HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores (SASS/LESS). Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git). Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban). Prática com testes de frontend (Jest, React Testing Library). Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful e práticas de DevOps/CI-CD. Familiaridade com ferramentas de design e prototipagem (Figma).Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem voltada para frontend. Possuir experiência com ferramentas de teste end-to-end como Cypress ou Playwright. Tiver experiência com Micro-frontends, Design Patterns e Clean Architecture aplicados ao Frontend. Dominar conceitos de Core Web Vitals, renderização no servidor (SSR), hidratação progressiva e estratégias de cache.Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing) Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM) Job Type: Full-TimeAbout Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand. We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company. About the Role This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach. Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.ResponsibilitiesActive Sourcing Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs. Candidate Outreach Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow Pipeline Management Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting What Success Looks Like Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over timeRequirements Must Have 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously Strong Plus Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach. Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.ResponsibilitiesActive Sourcing Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs. Candidate Outreach Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow Pipeline Management Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting What Success Looks Like Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over timeRequirements Must Have 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously Strong Plus Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads) Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)Who This Role Is For (& Not For) This Role Is For You If: You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does You are naturally proactive and internally driven You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time This Role Is NOT For You If: You need constant direction or external motivation You struggle with consistency and follow-through You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination onlyCompensation & Benefits Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience. Salary: Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company's growth and direction Fully remote: work from anywhere PTO: 2 Weeks Flex Day: An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery Thinking Day:one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness. Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet. Coaching credits:$1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional developmentReady to Apply? If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

Como Tech Lead React, você será responsável por guiar o time nas decisões arquiteturais, garantir a qualidade das entregas e promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, fomentando um ambiente colaborativo, de aprendizado contínuo e alta performance.Como será seu dia a dia? Prática com testes de frontend (Jest, React Testing Library). Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful e práticas de DevOps/CI-CD. Familiaridade com ferramentas de design e prototipagem (Figma).Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem voltada para frontend. Possuir experiência com ferramentas de teste end-to-end como Cypress ou Playwright. Tiver experiência com Micro-frontends, Design Patterns e Clean Architecture aplicados ao Frontend. Dominar conceitos de Core Web Vitals, renderização no servidor (SSR), hidratação progressiva e estratégias de cache.Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Spanish Or Portuguese Expert For Ai Training & Evaluation
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Spanish Or Portuguese Expert For Ai Training & Evaluation em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We're building a curated network of Spanish-speaking and Portuguese-speaking language professionals from Latin America to participate in AI training and evaluation projects with leading AI platforms, research labs, and data companies.This opportunity is ideal for translators, linguists, language professionals, bilingual communicators, and detail-oriented speakers interested in flexible, remote AI-related work. Candidates may apply with expertise in either Spanish OR Portuguese — proficiency in both languages is NOT required. Prior AI experience is NOT required. Unlike traditional full-time roles, these projects are task-based and platform-dependent. Work availability, compensation, and project duration may vary over time. About the Role Selected candidates may be guided through onboarding processes for AI training platforms working with multilingual datasets, language evaluation workflows, speech and text annotation, localization tasks, and AI-generated content review. Typical tasks may include:
- Reviewing, evaluating, and improving AI-generated text or speech outputs in Spanish or Portuguese
- Identifying linguistic inconsistencies, grammar issues, localization errors, or cultural nuances
- Supporting multilingual evaluation, annotation, transcription, translation, or content quality workflows Projects are generally flexible and remote, allowing contributors to work independently on their own schedules. Who We're Looking For We're primarily looking for:
- Spanish or Portuguese speakers
- Translators
- Linguists
- Language teachers
- Localization specialists
- Editors and proofreaders
- Communication or humanities students/professionals Preferred qualifications:
- Strong written communication skills
- Excellent grammar and attention to detail
- Solid English comprehension
- Experience in translation, editing, localization, or language-related work
- Ability to identify tone, nuance, and linguistic inconsistencies
- Familiarity with AI, language tools, or annotation platforms is a plus, but not required Important Transparency About the Process Vintti AI is NOT the company directly hiring for these projects. Our role is to identify and represent high-potential LATAM language talent, help candidates navigate onboarding and platform assessments, and share opportunities that may fit their backgrounds. We do not control platform acceptance decisions, project availability, task allocation, or future earnings. Compensation Compensation varies depending on the platform, the project, task complexity and contributor performance. Current market rates for language-related AI projects may range approximately between: USD 20–95/hour, depending on expertise, language specialization, and assignment type. These projects are generally best suited as flexible remote work, freelance income or an additional professional revenue stream, rather than a guaranteed full-time position. Vintti AI Representation Model This model helps support onboarding guidance, candidate support, project navigation and future access to additional AI-related opportunities. Full details are discussed transparently before any formal commitment. Why This Is Interesting AI companies increasingly need human language expertise — not just general annotators. Spanish and Portuguese speakers are becoming essential for training AI systems capable of multilingual communication, localization and translation, speech recognition, cultural adaptation, content evaluation and natural language understanding. This is an opportunity to participate directly in the development of next-generation AI systems while working remotely and flexibly.

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Treasury Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company's credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)
- Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.
- Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.
- Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.
- Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.
- Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.
- Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.
- Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.
- Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.
- Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.
- Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.
- Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.Cash Management & Treasury Operations
- Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.
- Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.
- Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.
- Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.
- Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.
- Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.
- Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.
- Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.
- Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities. Stakeholder Management
- Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.
- Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.
- Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization. Requirements Education
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Professional Experience
- Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.
- Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.Technical Knowledge
- Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.
- Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.
- Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Skills & Competencies
- Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.
- Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.
- Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.
- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
- Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Languages
- Advanced English (required).
- Intermediate Spanish (desirable).Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

title: Oracle Goldengate Data Engineer | Senior (Remote)
description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições Projetar, desenvolver e sustentar pipelines de dados escaláveis com foco em ingestão via CDC (Change Data Capture) utilizando Oracle GoldenGate;
Configurar e administrar replicações de dados em tempo real e quase tempo real entre sistemas origem e ambientes cloud;
Garantir consistência, integridade e sincronização dos dados entre origem e destino;
Monitorar pipelines de ingestão, atuar em troubleshooting e otimizar performance dos processos CDC;
Suportar estratégias decarga full e incremental (delta load);
Desenvolver e manter pipelines de processamento de dados utilizando Azure e Databricks (Spark);
Implementar transformações seguindo arquitetura moderna de dados no modelo Bronze, Silver e Gold;
Otimizar pipelines visando performance, escalabilidade e eficiência de custos;
Trabalhar com dados estruturados e semiestruturados para consumo analítico, relatórios e iniciativas de IA/ML;
Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos de dados na definição de arquiteturas modernas de Lakehouse;
Apoiar iniciativas de governança, catálogo de dados, lineage e compliance;
Garantir disponibilidade, confiabilidade, segurança e qualidade dos dados para consumo downstream.Requisitos e qualificaçõesGraduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prática e sólida com Oracle GoldenGate em processos de ingestão de dados e CDC (Change Data Capture), incluindo replicação em tempo real e quase tempo real;
Vivência no desenvolvimento, sustentação e otimização de pipelines de dados escaláveis e distribuídos;
Experiência com ecossistema Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake e Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2;
Forte conhecimento em Databricks e processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
Experiência em arquiteturas modernas de dados, como Lakehouse, trabalhando com camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold;
Vivência com cargas full e incrementais (delta load), garantindo integridade, consistência e sincronização dos dados;
Conhecimento em monitoramento de pipelines, troubleshooting, tuning de performance e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud;
Experiência com dados estruturados e semiestruturados voltados para analytics, reporting e iniciativas de IA/ML;
Conhecimento em governança de dados, catálogo, lineage, segurança e boas práticas de arquitetura corporativa;
Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de dados, times analíticos e stakeholders de negócio.

description:

seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.Compreensão e Análise de Negócio: ➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio. ➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e O foco será o atendimento da crescente demanda de revisão de processos de negócio, debatendo a estratégia e priorização das soluções com as equipes de negócio/operações e técnicas em busca do melhor retorno para a empresa e clientes de modo a sempre endereçar escalabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança.O que você precisa ter - Ter vivência na gestão de produtos;

- Atuado na definição eacompanhamento de métricas e objetivos de produtos (KPIs e OKRs);

- Capacidade de realizar negociação de escopo em iniciativas multidisciplinares;
- Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;
- Habilidade em escritatécnica;
- Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;

comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions Do you live inBRAZILand have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? Do you love to read, write, and analyze things? Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker? Can you type both fast and accurately? Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income? Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law? Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!About California Labor Solutions California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations? In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! title: Ai Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Creative Producer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative ProducerLocation:Remote Position Type:Contract Company:Pocket FMAbout Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across a diverse range of genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creativeCreative Producerto manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content. Role Overview As an AICreative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of voice design and performance across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and expertise in AI Voice design Tools.Key Responsibilities 1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements). 2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks. 3. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release. 4. AI-driven Innovations and tool adoption Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards. 5. Stakeholder Collaboration Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies. 6. Production Quality Oversight Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release. 7. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience. 8. Process & Workflow Optimization Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production. 9. Deliverables & Performance Expectations Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.Qualifications 3+ years of experience in content production, voice design, post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows. Strong understanding ofaudio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows. Proven experience working with Pro Tools, Elevenlabs, and similar platforms. Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production. Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Gastroenterologista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas emGastroenterologia!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade deGastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADESFornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration:1 yearEmployment type:Independent contractor agreement Location:Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone Reporting to:Senior Director Salary:Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location Application closing date:June 1st 9am BSTHow to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( About the Secure Energy Project The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.Who we're looking for We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.Media pitching and spokesperson training Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.Strategic support and special projects Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.About you: You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. You think strategically and you can also get things done. You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes. You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.Essential skills and experience 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.What we offer A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

Design end-to-end web experiences for enterprise clients — translating UX strategy into polished visual execution, from wireframes through final design, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality. ● Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites. ● Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability. ● Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution. ● Collaborate actively with PMs, UX strategists, and developers across every phase of the project. ● Present and communicate design decisions to clients with clarity and confidence. ● Balance multiple active projects simultaneously, managing your time efficiently across each. ● Contribute to a collaborative team culture — sharing feedback, flagging blockers early, and keeping work moving. ● Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life. ● Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality. ● Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.What We're Looking For ● 4+ years of web design experience, ideally within an agency setting. Ideally, with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities. ● Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end web projects with clear UX and visual thinking, including strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution. ● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking alongside visual craft. ● Comfortable working across a full project team — PMs, strategists, and developers — in a structured, waterfall workflow. ● Proven ability to lead client conversations, present creative directions, and navigate feedback professionally with clarity and confidence. ● Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences. ● Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles. ● High proficiency in Figma required.;
Webflow and Adobe Creative Suite a plus. ● Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred. ● Proactive and organized — capable of managing multiple projects and taking initiative without waiting to be directed. ● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.Why Join BX Studio? ● Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands. ● Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities. ● Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design. ● Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration:1 yearEmployment type:Independent contractor agreement Location:Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone Reporting to:Senior Director Salary:Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location Application closing date:June 1st 9am BSTHow to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( About the Secure Energy Project The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.Who we're looking for We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.Media pitching and spokesperson training Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.Strategic support and special projects Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.About you: You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. You think strategically and you can also get things done. You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes. You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.Essential skills and experience 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.What we offer A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

Somos a Saber, uma das maiores impulsionadoras da qualidade na educação pública no Brasil.

-Vivência profissional com vendas e prospecção de clientes.

title: Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

- Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

- Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

- Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

- Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

- Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

- Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

- Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

- Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

- Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

- At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

- Strong Python skills

- Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

- Real production experience with ML on AWS

- Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

- Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

- Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

- A strong eye for correctness and data quality

- Business level English

- The ability to work independently in a small remote team

- A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

- 12 month B2B contract

- Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

- Flat structure with direct communication

- Production product with real users and real data problems

- Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

- Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado. Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal. Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas. Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais. Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro. Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão. Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação. Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados. Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação). title: Engenheiro De Dados Aws
description:

Banco de Talentos — Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (AWS)Sobre a DataEX: Com12 anos de atuaçãono mercado, aDataEXé uma consultoria especializada emDados e IA, com parcerias estratégicas comMicrosoft, AWS e Databricks, atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos ainovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida, comincentivos para certificações e bem-estar.Contexto do Banco de Talentos: Estamos coletando perfis com foco emEngenharia de Dados em ambientes AWS e de Streamingpara compor o nossoBanco de Talentos para futuras oportunidades!Perfil técnico esperado: Experiência prática com data lakes, data mesh e serviços da AWS, incluindo Amazon Web Services (AWS Glue, Kinesis, Redshift, Athena, Aurora e S3). Experiência com arquitetura e processamento de dados em tempo real (real-time processing) e batch, utilizando serviços AWS para construção de pipelines escaláveis, resilientes e de baixa latência, incluindo ingestão contínua de eventos, processamento incremental, integração entre sistemas e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven architecture). Experiência com tecnologias e padrões de streaming, como AWS Kinesis, Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming / Structured Streaming ou equivalentes, aplicados à construção, monitoramento e otimização de pipelines de dados streaming, processamento distribuído e soluções de alta disponibilidade. Capacidade de desenvolver APIs e implementar soluções utilizando PySpark em ambientes como Databricks e EMR. Experiência na configuração e otimização de recursos e clusters na AWS. Desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de pipelines de dados, incluindo arquitetura Lambda. Estruturação e gestão de arquitetura de dados em múltiplas camadas (raw, bronze, silver e gold). Elaboração de documentação técnica e condução de sessões de transferência de conhecimento (KT) das soluções implementadas. Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis como Scrum, Kanban e Lean.Diferenciais: Certificações da AWS: Certified Data Engineer – Associate. Atuação prévia e comprovada em projetos internacionais (ex.: Espanha, Itália, México, Alemanha) Espanhol intermediárioEscopo de Atuação: Desenvolver, manter e evoluir pipelines de dados conforme demandas do projeto. Estruturar e aprimorar a arquitetura de dados (camadas raw, bronze, silver e gold). Garantir a documentação técnica das soluções entregues. Realizar transferência de conhecimento das implementações realizadas à equipe interna, quando aplicável.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst - 57510 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Turing:Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&LAbout the Role: We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.Responsibilities: Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance. Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies. Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions. Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently. Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks. Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows. Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.Requirements: Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting. Experience working with browser extensions and online tools. Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required). Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively. Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis. Good written communication skills in English.Nice to Have: Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work. Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments. Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise. Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment. Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details: Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum. Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave). Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.Application Process: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge. Once the assessment is cleared, you're ready to start contributing!After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
